Présentation des solutions technologique: Presentation of technological solutions for the energy sector
Ooredoo Algérie a présenté ses solutions: Ooredoo Algeria presented its technological solutions for companies in the energy sector at the NAPEC 2026 exhibition. Through its Ooredoo Business entity, the company showcased several innovative tools aimed at supporting the digital transformation of professionals.
